random_stratified_5fold_cv.scientific_critique: Random cross-validation splits pixels from the same open-cast pit between train and test sets, measuring spatial proximity rather than geological prospectivity.

spatially_blocked_leave_group_out_cv.scientific_critique: When entire mining complexes are withheld, optical reflectance alone drops to 47.7% accuracy (near random guess) due to regolith and tropical laterite confounding.

scientific_decision_and_data_gap_report.status_label: Unavailable — Awaiting Independent Spatial Validation & Geophysical Data
root_cause_analysis: Sentinel-2 Level-2A measures surface reflectance in the upper micrometers of the Earth surface. In tropical lateritic terrains like Singhbhum-North Odisha, ferruginous duricrust, lateritic soils, and weathered granite slopes exhibit high ferric iron ratios (B04/B02 > 0.98), mimicking open hematite mine benches.
Optical bands cannot differentiate surface laterite staining from an economic high-grade hematite body (>62% Fe) without subsurface core assays or regional aeromagnetic data.
The random holdout accuracy of 83.5% is an artifact of spatial autocorrelation (neighboring pixels). Under true spatial block validation, accuracy collapses to 47.7%.
Deploying a standalone optical model under these conditions would violate scientific integrity by emitting uncalibrated, misleading prospectivity predictions.
mandatory_prerequisites_for_future_iron_: Integration of GSI National Aeromagnetic Anomaly Tensor Grid (magnetic BIF susceptibility contrast).
Subsurface diamond core borehole assay database (% Fe, % SiO2, % Al2O3, % P).
Digitized 1:50,000 lithological contact boundaries of Banded Hematite Jasper (BHJ) from Bhukosh.
Independent multi-region validation on Bastar Craton (Bailadila) and Dharwar Craton (Sandur/Donimalai) before nationwide deployment.
